Name: Stardew Vineyard for Artisanal Soda Makers - OBSOLETE
Author: QuillSnow
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=2][center][i]THIS MOD IS DEPRECATED - IT USES JSON ASSETS, AND WAS MADE FOR 1.5. FIND THE MIGRATED CONTENT PATCHER VERSION [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34054]HERE[/url]﻿. I DO NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS VERSION, IT'S JUST UP FOR PEOPLE THAT DON'T WANT TO UPDATE THE GAME TO 1.6.[/i][/center][/size]

[size=2]This mod is a content pack for the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url][size=2] mod, using wine grape varieties from the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5912]Stardew Vineyard[/url][size=2] mod. Each item has gift tastes for all the vanilla villagers.[/size]
[color=#f4f4f4]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
[/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]Install SMAPI and [i]all[/i] of this mod's dependencies.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]Download the latest release of this mod from the files tab, and unzip it into your Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]To uninstall this mod, sell or trash all items added by this mod, make sure your machines aren't producing any of the items, and then delete the mod from your Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma][size=2]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Special Thanks[/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][font=Tahoma][size=2]Many thanks to Hadi and Amburr for their mods, without which this mod could not exist.[/size][/font][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][font=Tahoma][size=2]A huge thank you to fwippy for all her help when I was first getting started with this mod![/size][/font][/color]
[/list]
[size=4][font=Tahoma][color=#f4f4f4]More From Me[/color][/font][color=#f4f4f4]
[/color][/size][list]
[*]Check out my Stardew Valley blog, Bluesky, and Nexus Profile on my [url=https://quillsmods.carrd.co/]Carrd[/url]﻿. If you really really want to track the granular progress of my modmaking shenanigans, there's also a trello workspace linked with boards for my mods!
[/list]
